repos_data.description: p5.js is a client-side JS platform that empowers artists, designers, students, and anyone to learn to code and express themselves creatively on the web. It is based on the core principles of Processing. Looking for p5.js 2.0? http://beta.p5js.org
openFrameworks is a community-developed cross platform toolkit for creative coding in C++.

TouchDesigner MCP server, describe a visual to Claude, Cursor or Codex and it builds a real, playable node network (audio-reactive, generative, particle, 3D, feedback) with live knobs + MIDI/OSC/DMX, then checks for errors and previews its own work.
